title: Warehouse management
goal: Capture warehouse receiving and fulfillment functions with a short-pick exception.

rubric.must: Warehouse Management System visibly bounds the warehouse use cases.
Receive Shipment and Pick Order each have a dashed «include» arrow pointing to Scan Goods.
Resolve Short Pick extends Pick Order toward the short pick extension point.
The external ERP System actor is associated with Release Pick Wave and Confirm Shipment.
Forklift Operator generalizes to Picker with a hollow triangle.
